notes.title: Art Nouveau
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32748111/a2e3bc034d44b265601d9b601e29fe3e0d4d9e84.png[/img]

Hey all! We've done some bug fixing so now the game should run quite a bit smoother. Some of the platforms didn't quite sync up in some of the worlds (1-9) and there were a couple other fun little bugs.

We're also working on a mini-story where you can play as the Master Painter when he was younger. We'll be introducing a new art style for this as well - Art Nouveau! We're pretty excited to create some levels with it. As a min-story we probably won't do a full 10 levels per world, more like 5, but that still means a total of 10 levels and 2 bosses! Plus more background story. No release date yet on that as we'll have to change around our current code quite a bit to allow for a separate story, but hopefully it won't take too long.
